result.summary: Found 2 notable issues: a critical data bug showing '€NaN delivery', and a minor layout issue with a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' — a JavaScript NaN value leaking into the UI instead of a price.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee parsing/calculation so it renders a valid price, or hide the fee line when the value is missing/unknown.

issues.description: The last category filter chip is cut off at the right edge, showing only a sliver of text, which looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Either ensure the chip list is horizontally scrollable with a visible affordance/gradient, or adjust spacing so the partial chip is not awkwardly clipped.
